message: You know, there's nothing quite like the feeling of having a plan in place for those unexpected moments. I often think about what I would do if my phone or tech decided to give up on me when I needed it most. That's why having a well-thought-out kit at home can bring a sense of calm. It’s like having a cozy blanket ready for a chilly evening — comforting and reassuring. Do you have a little stash of essentials just in case?
